scope: Static MCI contract and immutable media availability; runtime playback not captured

loop.behavior: On successful matching MCI completion and enabled loop flag, reissue original from/to range

stop: Clear loop flag and send MCI_STOP
close: Clear loop flag, STOP, CLOSE, clear device id
failure: Initialization retries after timer delay and emits game text; missing device play helper itself returns true but owning state separately tracks initialized device
availability: Audio stored in MDF outside Bhunter.bin; full track retained unchanged
limits: No audio byte-order conversion/export or audible playback verified
Frame/time/loop behavior statically identified, not a measured original runtime scenario
